focus: What FigJam is the only output actually constrains

findings.label: The phase directive is stricter than the topic: findings only, and no file outside the research folder changes, so during research no board is touched.
FigJam-only excludes every artifact the diagram skill ships: HTML/SVG documents, ASCII markdown flowcharts, PNG/SVG exports and drawio or Mermaid redraws.
Product Owner blocks delivery until a markdown artifact is saved and read back from its exact path, so board-only delivery requires redefining the receipt rather than dropping the step.
The only board read-back is fj list|info|nodes, which proves nodes exist but not that labels and edges are correct, so a correctness proof also needs the model in text.
The packet's completion criteria require the synthesis to tag every claim confirmed or inferred and to carry a copy-and-avoid section for each precedent.

The coherent reading is one delivered artifact (the board) plus a non-deliverable verification receipt recording the node read-back and the model that produced it; otherwise topic and protocol contradict.
